mapper.delete: delete from meal_plan where user_id = #{userId} and plan_date between #{start} and #{end}
mapper.insert:
insert into meal_plan (user_id, plan_date, meal_type, dish_id, dish_name, planned_calorie, adopted, create_time, update_time) values
(#{p.userId}, #{p.planDate}, #{p.mealType}, #{p.dishId}, #{p.dishName}, #{p.plannedCalorie}, #{p.adopted}, #{p.createTime}, #{p.updateTime})
mapper.select: select id, user_id, plan_date, meal_type, dish_id, dish_name, planned_calorie, adopted, create_time, update_time from meal_plan where user_id = #{userId} and plan_date between #{start} and #{end} order by plan_date asc, field(meal_type, '早餐', '午餐', '晚餐', '加餐') asc, id asc
mapper.update: update meal_plan set adopted = 1, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
